text: This week, CMP2946 (Chandler Martin Page) as a Salesman in the RegionalSales team has triggered rule R4 due to an atypical number of visits to job-search sites. Specifically, they visited these sites 7 times this week, which is well above their usual range and also higher than what peers with the same role typically visit during this time frame (1). This suggests that CMP2946 may be experiencing some level of job dissatisfaction or searching for new opportunities outside of their typical browsing habits.
